verdict.rationale: The cloud agent runs tasks in the background on GitHub. Tasks can be launched from GitHub, tracked from a centralized session page, and steered later by mentioning @copilot on a pull request. Because this state lives in the cloud, it can implicitly be picked up from another device or a browser. However, no evidence documents explicit cross-device session handoff, such as resuming a local IDE or CLI chat session elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit docs on continuing a session across devices, IDE/CLI-to-browser session resume, and hands-on corroboration.
